scenes.title: A Sparkle in the Woods
scenes.body: One morning, a little fox woke up in its cozy den and saw something sparkle far away. It rubbed its eyes and looked again. The sparkle was still there, like a tiny star hiding in the forest. The fox stepped out and followed it.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: The Curious Trail
scenes.body: The sparkle led the fox along a winding path. Over a mossy log, under a big fern, and around a patch of bright blue flowers. Then the fox saw a round stone with a shiny silver stripe. The sparkle seemed to point the way.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: A Friend by the Stream
scenes.body: The stone trail ended at a bubbling little stream. On the other side stood a small fluffy badger, looking at the water. The fox gave a friendly bark. The badger waved, and together they found more shiny stones that hopped across the stream like magic.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: The Hidden Meadow
scenes.body: After crossing the stream, the two friends peeked through the willow branches. There lay a tiny meadow full of soft violet flowers. Every flower turned its face to the sun, and the air smelled like honey. The fox and the badger sat down to watch the sparkles dance on the petals.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: A Perfect Discovery
scenes.body: The sun turned the meadow gold, and the two friends smiled. The little fox knew it had found more than a sparkle. It had found a new friend and a beautiful place to share. And that was the best curiosity adventure of all.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about curiosity.
